adjudication.rationale: In `app/models/topic_embed.rb`, `eh = EmbeddableHost.record_for_host(url)` can be `nil`/`false` (record_for_host returns `false` on parse failures or no host match), and the code passes `category: eh.try(:category_id)` into `PostCreator`. The diff shows no local fallback in `TopicEmbed.import` if `eh` is missing. However, other parts of the diff add host validation via `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?` (e.g. `TopicRetriever#invalid_host?`, `EmbedController#ensure_embeddable`), so in the normal request path `eh` should exist and this may not manifest as a concrete defect. Still, it’s a real, diff-grounded edge case/defensive-programming gap rather than a clearly verifiable bug.
